ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimMind - Actions (v2.0)[/h1] Composite ToolCall orchestration and tactical emergency execution engine for RimWorld colonists. Translates high-level AI intentions into safe, multi-step in-game operations—covering battlefield triage, spatial blueprint construction, room planning, resource designation, worktable bills, zone management, survival apparel, and buildable-structure queries.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]v2.0 Composite ToolCall Architecture[/b]: Combines atomic Core mechanisms and Verse operations into self-describing composite tools registered purely through [code]RimMind-Core[/code] public ToolCall contracts. [*][b]Spatial Placement & Continuous Construction Chaining[/b]: Evaluates room topology, peer clustering, and interaction cells via [code]ColonySpatialClusterSolver[/code], then chains [code]Blueprint_Build[/code] to [code]Frame[/code] delivery and construction through [code]RimMindAPI.Agent.StartIntentSession[/code]. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]11 Built-In Composite Tools[/b] - High-level orchestrated tools covering emergency survival, spatial construction, resource designation, worktable bills, zones, equipment, and dynamic structure queries. [*][b]ConstructionIntentChainer & Spatial Placement[/b] - Scores candidate cells using room roles, wall adjacency, and footprints, then attaches continuous [code]Blueprint_Build[/code] to [code]Frame[/code] construction leases via [code]RimMindAPI.Agent.StartIntentSession[/code]. [*][b]ActionPermissionGuard & ResourceSafetyGuard[/b] - Validates active spawned colonist eligibility, tri-state autonomy permissions, fixed and stuffed material costs, and concurrent blueprint caps before mutating map state. [*][b]Self-Describing Tool Manifests[/b] - Every tool declares explicit autonomy domains, risk levels, scopes, and aliases through [code]ToolManifest[/code] and [code]IToolPolicyClassifier[/code]. [*][b]Main-Thread Safe Execution[/b] - Enforces Unity main-thread guards and executes all Verse mutations safely on the main game thread. [/list]

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: Can RimMind-Actions be used standalone?[/b] A: Actions registers 11 composite tools into [code]RimMind-Core[/code]. Pair it with [code]RimMind-Advisor[/code] so AI colonists can autonomously propose and execute these tools.
[b]Q: Will AI colonists waste scarce resources on blueprints?[/b] A: No. [code]ResourceSafetyGuard[/code] verifies both stuffed and fixed material requirements against colony reserves and caps concurrent active blueprints before placing any blueprint.
